Boqian New Materials.why: Supplies nickel powder for MLCC electrodes; the company calls itself an important supplier of nickel powder for MLCC and expects to benefit from high-end (AI server) MLCC demand
Boqian New Materials.evidence: Boqian New Materials investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-17-2026): the company has long-term stable cooperation with the world's leading MLCC manufacturers and multiple nickel-based product specifications are in volume supply

players.product: Ultra-fine, high-purity nickel-based powders for MLCC electrodes (volume supply to global MLCC makers); also copper and silver-coated copper powders

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials IR activity record: 2026-008 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (H1 2026 results briefing, IR record): in H1 2026 higher product sales volumes drove fast revenue growth as the business scaled, while raw-material purchasing, production and operating inputs rose accordingly and gross margin declined; the company does not forecast or quantify future product prices or gross margin and said it cannot judge the size of the H2 gross-margin change.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials IR activity record: 2026-008 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company's copper powder for photovoltaic (low-silver / silver-free) electrodes passed multi-batch sample qualification at leading domestic PV companies and moved from R&D to volume production; H1 2026 shipments grew substantially year on year. The company gives no timetable for a scaled profit contribution, which depends on cell-technology switching, customer purchasing and silver prices; copper-based revenue also includes copper powder for electronic pastes and silver-coated copper powder.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials IR activity record: 2026-008 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): as some makers optimise product lines, MLCC industry resources are concentrating on high-value, high-reliability and high-growth applications; as the high-end MLCC share rises, the performance requirements for ultra-fine, high-purity, highly consistent and highly reliable nickel powder rise. As an important supplier of nickel powder for MLCC, the company expects to benefit from the MLCC mix upgrade and high-end MLCC demand growth, but cannot judge share shifts or order transfers from any single maker's product-line change. It will focus on raising its supply capacity of nickel powder for high-end MLCC and release capacity according to project progress and demand.
